slice: Standalone f64 Rust/Python GICP surface-shape preparation. Existing registration, ICP, odometry, initialization gates and defaults unchanged. Prepared-target caching and online adoption remain subsequent work.
api: gicp_shapes(points,*,neighbors=20,parallel=False,capture_neighbors=False). All input points are eligible neighbors, including the query itself. Neighbors >=5, clipped to input size. Return owned shapes (N,3,3), supported bool(N), signed ascending population scatter eigenvalues (N,3), counts(N), and optional neighbor indices/squared distances (N,K); uncaptured neighbor arrays have width zero.
matching: Existing exact f64 KdTree::nearest_k_into, no SIMD/hints. Preserve existing distance ordering and deterministic traversal ties; no smallest-original-index promise. Queries are the input points in original order. Validate all finite inputs before tree construction; empty inputs valid, oversized target index space rejected. Runtime arithmetic overflow gives first query-index error, including nonfinite captured kNN distances.
algebra: For each selected neighborhood, sum query-relative offsets in neighbor order, divide once by k, then centered offset outer products in that same order and divide population scatter by k. Symmetrize by constructing lower entries and reflecting. Scale finite scatter by its max absolute entry before existing f64 Jacobi eigen solve, rescale eigenvalues, sort by value then original axis. Normalize the smallest-eigenvalue vector in f64. C=I+(.001-1)*n*n.T. No f32 normals, orientation sign, eigenvalue floor or calibrated covariance inference.
support: At least five neighbors, finite eigenvalues, largest >0 and middle >1e-12*largest. Unsupported rows return zero shapes and supported=False; no identity fallback. Fewer than five neighbors report zero eigenvalues. Repeated minimum eigenvalues have an arbitrary deterministic eigenspace direction; no new eigengap rejection gate.
parallel: Indexed 64-query chunks, independent per-chunk kNN scratch, serial identical arithmetic per query. Collect rows in original order and return first indexed runtime failure. All serial/parallel output bits and errors must agree. Serial remains default pending separately frozen performance study.
tests: Closed-form planes/lines/coincident/empty/small point sets, repeated eigenvalues/tied distances, off-axis/world translation/rotation/uniform scale, invalid parameters/nonfinite/overflow, f64 SPD outputs and no fallback, strided/copied/owned results, deterministic serial/parallel outputs/errors. Synthetic controls are unit tests only.

real.input: 36 immutable PR297 fixed-map NPZ inputs (four cases x rows [0,1,2,9,17,33,49,60,63]). Source/target inputs were all supported in the old shape model; no reference trajectory or new map insertion.
real.shape_checks: 72 point sets. Compare exact native kNN distance ranks with blocked exhaustive NumPy search, including distinct valid IDs and native distance arithmetic. Independently rebuild scatter/eigenvalues/support/shapes on native selected neighbors. Compare the old SciPy-20-neighbor shapes separately, reporting boundary ties, support differences and shape differences without claiming identical neighbor sets on ties.
real.eigenspace: Require shape-matrix agreement where (lambda1-lambda0)/lambda2 >1e-10. For repeated/near-repeated minima retain support, report ambiguity and shape difference, and independently verify unit normal eigenpair residual and shape eigenvalues [.001,1,1]. No silent exclusion from registration.
real.registration: Run unchanged GICP with native-produced supported shapes and same predeclared predictions, center, 2m threshold, unit weights, 30 iterations and 1e-4m/1e-5rad step tolerances. Compare every outer iteration and trial with the independent NumPy/SciPy iterative oracle using the new native shape inputs. Report changes relative to the frozen old-shape registration separately. No trajectory/gate/default adoption.
real.preservation: Keep every old protocol/controller/native/source/output verbatim. Complete private native package only; never overwrite the installed extension.

regression: Run native Python/core checks and existing 660-scan full-motion and 185-scan frontend regressions. New audit evaluates the unchanged caller-shape API on frozen inputs and checks old native outputs. Preserve all prior snapshots/receipts. Include LF checkout attributes for the new public packet/controller before publication.
scope: Native shape preparation and independent fixed-map numerical validation only. No physical accuracy/observability/calibration, initializer fit, whole-SLAM speed, GPU or timing claim in this protocol. Any timing uses a separate protocol frozen before measurement.
